notes.title: ARSONIST | News
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34104123/9af875d9754fcbfa26e939c48a6dd49f9497f376.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,

Development of the game is going well, and there is not much to report on. 
We still have quite a lot of work to do. The last weeks we have been worked on level design, visuals and game mechanics. 
So, I can't say certainty when we are planning to release, but we're going to do out best over the next months to bring the game up to a stable state

We are here today to share with you some new screenshots.

[i]Just want to remind you that we have a public Discord Group. If you are interested check it out over [url=https://discord.gg/D3aMySX]>>HERE<<[/url][/i]

notes.title: ARSONIST playtest Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34104123/2da42a5272ebb3847d7d2ea46c84f8196294504c.jpg[/img]
Hey hey! 
[h1]You are welcome to test ARSONIST at the weekend!  -> 
[url=https://discord.gg/D3aMySX ] https://discord.gg/D3aMySX [/url][/h1]

This week our team has made very important thingse and we have updated the build today (check it at Steam)! 
This version will contain the SAVE system. You may create up to 3 game profiles and choose any at game launch. 
LEADERBOARDS You can see your current rating on the result screen (if you find the way out) and compare your level score to the other players. 
The LEVELS were also updated (geometry, goals).
A lot of few improvements are also made.

Please let us know how you feel the game. Drop us quick answers to the survey   --> 
[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/T7VGR7P] https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/T7VGR7P[/url]

Have a good weekend! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Playtest date – 22nd, Jan
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34104123/ec7c702645cecc2869dc3594721485a59fee9c30.gif[/img]
[h1][b]Thanks everyone for signing up for the Arsonist playtest![/b][/h1]

It will go live on [u]Tuesday the 22nd, January[/u].
You will recieve you Steam beta key on discord when it opens. 

[i]The game is in alpha state and we plan to add many QoL improvements, content and features later to make a smoother experience. Take it easy! [/i]

If you have any questions, you can ask EvilCG Team developer and we will try to help you out!

Thanks for helping us test the game!
/EvilCoGames Teamːsteamhappyː
